note: _aperuisset_ (has opened). Mistake for _accepisset_ (has received). – Heinrich Joseph Vogels: _Handbuch der Textkritik des Neuen Testaments_. 2nd edition. Bonn 1955 (viii, 236 pp.), p. 104. – In the same verse: _odoramenta_ (plur.) – odours (Douay version), incense (Ronald Knox), for classical _odores_.

_divinitatem_ (Weber/Gryson, Clementina) – deity, Gottheit. Mistake for _divitias_ – wealth, Reichtum. – Heinrich Joseph Vogels: _Handbuch der Textkritik des Neuen Testaments_. 2nd edition. Bonn 1955 (viii, 236 pp.), pp. 103–104. The Nova Vulgata, in fact, has _divitias_.
